title: Why every developer should learn Rust in 2026

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Rust’s memory safety and zero-cost abstractions make it essential for modern system development. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Not every developer needs low-level control—most work in web, mobile, or AI, where Rust isn’t required. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: But with WebAssembly and rising demand for secure, performant code, Rust’s relevance grows across all stacks. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Even if Rust is useful, it’s not mandatory—Python, JavaScript, and Go dominate in their domains. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Learn what you need, not what’s trendy—Rust isn’t for every developer in 2026. (4 sec)
